description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractField' that implements common functionality for CRON expression fields, including methods to evaluate whether a certain date value satisfies various CRON pattern conditions such as ranges and increments.

classes.name: AbstractField
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to evaluate CRON expression fields, including range and interval checks.

methods.name: isSatisfied
methods.description: Determines if a given date value satisfies the CRON field conditions based on ranges and increments.

methods.name: isRange
methods.description: Checks if a value represents a range (contains a hyphen).

methods.name: isIncrementsOfRanges
methods.description: Checks if a value denotes an increments of ranges (contains a slash).

methods.name: isInRange
methods.description: Determines if a date value falls within a specified range.

methods.name: isInIncrementsOfRanges
methods.description: Checks if a date value falls within an increments-of-ranges pattern.
